name: bjsonvalue-test-248ac7be19/null-json-to-float-p.bal
reason: The case uses supported functions, local declarations, a nil literal stored in json, a call, and a type cast. The asserted TypeCastError panic for casting the nil JSON value to float is the failure behavior of the supported type-cast expression; no subset restriction excludes this cast or its panic.
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion checks the TypeCastError reason and incompatible-types message for () to float; main invokes the function so the failing cast executes. No @args or @output assertions.
